claims.claim: Oracle Q1 FY2027 revenue reached $19.3B, up 30%, cloud revenue $11.6B, up 62%, and IaaS revenue $7.4B, up 121%; RPO reached $664B.

factors.name: AI/cloud infrastructure exposure
factors.basis: triple-digit IaaS growth and very large RPO indicate accelerating infrastructure demand

risks.risk: Large RPO requires substantial datacenter buildout and successful long-duration contract conversion.

causalEdges.from: AI model and cloud compute demand
causalEdges.mechanism: Oracle adds datacenter capacity against contracted cloud demand
causalEdges.falsifier: RPO conversion, IaaS growth or capacity deployment slows materially

unknowns.unknown: Customer concentration within the new RPO and contract economics are not established here.

claims.claim: Oracle delivered 850MW of additional datacenter capacity in Q1 FY2027 while GAAP EPS rose 55% to $1.56 and non-GAAP EPS rose 30% to $1.92.

factors.name: capacity execution
factors.basis: physical capacity delivery accompanied strong revenue and earnings growth

risks.risk: Rapid capacity expansion can pressure capital intensity and returns if demand conversion disappoints.

causalEdges.mechanism: new MW enable contracted cloud workloads to enter service
causalEdges.falsifier: capacity grows without corresponding cloud revenue/cash return

unknowns.unknown: No canonical valuation or return-on-incremental-capital conclusion is asserted.
